description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class named WebConfig that sets up Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) settings and OpenAPI metadata for the Notes Backend application.

classes.name: WebConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that defines beans to configure CORS settings for REST API endpoints and to provide OpenAPI metadata for the API documentation.

methods.name: corsConfigurer
methods.description: Defines a bean that returns a WebMvcConfigurer with CORS mappings allowing cross-origin requests to '/api/**' with common HTTP methods and any headers.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Defines a bean that returns an OpenAPI object with specific metadata such as title, version, description, contact info, and external documentation link for API documentation purposes.
